meta.description: Golden vectors captured from legacy Insurance CRM finance.js for the prospect-profiler CRM port. Replay: for each vector call <fn>(args) (strip the _grid key, it is grid bookkeeping only) and assert deep-equality with <result> (floats: exact if op order preserved, else relative epsilon 1e-9). Vectors with fn prefixed "caller:" replay formulas re-implemented inline in ClientReportModal.jsx / CPFProjection.jsx (see each vector note).
meta.timeDependence: ONLY ageFromDOB is time-dependent (new Date().getFullYear()). Its vectors are valid only when reference year == captureYear. The ported function must accept an injectable reference date; tests must pass captureYear.

argConventions.retirementSumsFor: single arg dob string "YYYY-MM-DD" or null
argConventions.ageFromDOB: single arg dob string or null — TIME-DEPENDENT
argConventions.caller:raAssessment: composite: projectCPFTo55(args) + retirementSumsFor(args.dob), then formulas in note
argConventions.caller:gapAnalysis: pure formulas over constants + args, see note
